title: Where Language Models Fail Like Aphasic Patients and Where They Don't
abstract: arXiv:2611.18591v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The computational architecture of human word production -- whether semantic-lexical retrieval and phonological encoding constitute dissociable processing stages -- has been debated for decades using hand-designed models with small vocabularies. We introduce computational architectural dissociation: using known architectural properties of vision-language models (VLMs) to derive falsifiable predictions about which patient error types should and should not align with model errors under perturbation. Because VLMs perform picture naming through learned semantic competition over full vocabularies but lack phonological encoding entirely, perturbation-induced errors should match patient patterns for semantic-stage categories but not phonological ones. translated_title: 语言模型在哪些方面像失语症患者一样出错，哪些方面则不然
translated_abstract: 人类词汇产生的计算架构——即语义-词汇提取与语音编码是否构成可分离的处理阶段——几十年来一直通过使用小词汇量的手工设计模型进行争论。我们提出了“计算架构分离”方法：利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）已知的架构特性，推导出可证伪的预测，判断在扰动下哪些患者错误类型应当与模型错误一致，哪些不应一致。由于VLM通过对完整词汇表进行学习到的语义竞争来完成图片命名，但完全缺乏语音编码环节，因此扰动引发的错误应当在语义阶段的类别上与患者模式相符，而在语音类错误上不相符。通过将LLaVA 1.6（Vicuna-13B）与88名失语症患者在175个费城命名测试项目上进行对比（约3700万次命名尝试，50个扰动种子），我们发现八个错误类别中的六个……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出“计算架构分离”新方法，利用视觉语言模型“有完整词汇语义竞争但无语音编码”的架构特性做出可证伪预测，并通过与88名失语症患者约3700万次命名尝试的对比发现模型扰动错误与患者的语义类错误相符而与语音类错误不符，为词汇产生中语义提取与语音编码是可分离阶段提供了证据。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "computational architectural dissociation," using vision-language models' architectural properties (full-vocabulary semantic competition but no phonological encoding) to derive falsifiable predictions, showing across 88 aphasic patients and ~37 million naming attempts that perturbation-induced errors match patients' semantic-stage error patterns but not phonological ones.
